capabilities: Show synonyms for a selected word or phrase and replace the selection on click
Show definitions by part of speech in a popover on Ctrl/Cmd-select
Cache every lookup as a properties-only note read before the network is asked again
Download whole dictionaries (Open English WordNet, Wiktionary) for offline lookups
Look up words in several languages using Wiktionary's per-language sections
extras: Desktop only (downloads use Node modules). Datamuse will require an API key from early 2027, which the plugin does not yet support, possibly breaking new synonym lookups; definitions are unaffected. Free, MIT, no account or telemetry; sends only the selected word to the lookup services.
intentEvidence: a separate program, written from scratch in Rust, and shares no code with it
problem: Obsidian has no built-in thesaurus or dictionary, so checking a word's synonyms or meaning means leaving the editor or an external site.

relations.evidence: Synonyms | The Datamuse API (/words?ml=…, the entries tagged syn;
Definitions | Wiktionary through the MediaWiki Action API

summary: Editor tool that shows synonyms for a selected word and replaces it on click, or definitions on Ctrl-select, keeping each lookup as a note.
